servers.name: Tongdaxin
servers.description_zh: 通过通达信查询股票行情、条件选股、研报、公告和宏观数据。
servers.description_en: Look up market data, screen stocks, and explore research reports, announcements and macroeconomic data with Tongdaxin.
examples_zh: 帮我查贵州茅台（600519）最近的研究报告
筛选市盈率低于 20、净资产收益率高于 15% 的 A 股
查询近期宏观经济政策动向
对比三家半导体行业公司的基本面数据
examples_en: Find recent research reports on Kweichow Moutai (600519).
Screen A-shares with a P/E below 20 and ROE above 15%.
Compare the fundamentals of three semiconductor companies.

servers.name: WeCom
servers.description_zh: 在授权范围内查询和管理企业微信文档、日程、待办及通讯录。
servers.description_en: Access WeCom documents, calendars, tasks and contacts.
examples_zh: 帮我列出企业微信今天的日程

servers.name: Feishu
servers.description_zh: 查询飞书消息、文档和日历，管理工作区任务。
servers.description_en: Search Feishu messages and documents and manage calendar events and tasks.
examples_zh: 列出我本周在飞书的日程
examples_en: List my Feishu calendar events this week.

servers.name: DingTalk
servers.description_zh: 查询钉钉联系人、日程、文档及待办。
servers.description_en: Work with DingTalk contacts, calendars, documents and tasks.
examples_zh: 查一下我今天的钉钉日程
examples_en: Show my DingTalk schedule for today.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description_zh: 连接 GitHub 账号，管理仓库、Issue、Pull Request 和 Actions。
servers.description_en: Connect your GitHub account to manage repositories, issues, pull requests and Actions.
examples_zh: 列出我在 GitHub 上等待评审的 Pull Request
examples_en: List GitHub pull requests awaiting my review.

servers.name: Notion
servers.description_zh: 搜索、读取和更新已授权的 Notion 页面与数据库。
servers.description_en: Search, read and update authorized Notion pages and databases.
examples_zh: 查找我最近更新的 Notion 项目文档
examples_en: Find my recently updated Notion project documents.

servers.name: Baidu Netdisk
servers.description_zh: 浏览网盘文件、搜索文档、查询容量和管理分享链接。
servers.description_en: Browse Baidu Netdisk files, find documents, check storage and manage shares.
examples_zh: 列出百度网盘根目录最近修改的文件
examples_en: List recently modified files in my Baidu Netdisk root folder.
